name: codex-qquse
description: Use a locally connected QQ account through a restricted OneBot v11 MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to a local SnowLuma or compatible OneBot v11 HTTP endpoint to find chats, read recent messages, and send plain text with explicit user approval.
defaultPrompt: 查看我的 QQ 连接状态
帮我查找一个 QQ 群并读取最近消息
